landingIntro: A little curiosity on your commute or during a break. Learn at your own pace with KAQ, from AWS basics to AWS certification learning.
freeStudyAnswer: Practice questions, mock exams, and reviewing incorrect answers are free. Creating an account is free too.
guestStudyQuestion: Can I study without an account?
guestStudyAnswer: You can practice questions, take mock exams, and review incorrect answers without signing up. If you allow storage on this device, guest study records stay on this device.
accountTradeoffsQuestion: Are there any downsides to creating an account?
accountTradeoffsAnswer: You need to sign in through an external service. We use your sign-in provider’s user ID and basic profile information you agree to share, such as your email address, for authentication. Study records saved to a signed-in KAQ account sync across devices. A learning analytics dashboard is still being prepared.
mockFormatQuestion: Can I choose the number of questions and the time limit for a mock exam?
mockFormatAnswer: Choose Short, Medium, Full, or Custom. You can see the question count and time limit before starting. Custom lets you set the number of questions.
answerExplanationsQuestion: Can I see explanations after answering?
answerExplanationsAnswer: After answering, you can see why each option is correct or incorrect. You can also open the relevant official AWS documentation.
commuteStudyQuestion: Can I study during a short commute?
commuteStudyAnswer: Answer a single question on your phone while you wait for the train or bus. Read the explanation as soon as you answer. If you have a little more time, try a short mock exam.
studyPathsIntro: Start with the basics or practice with certification questions and mock exams.
fundamentalsEntry: Explore planned courses on AWS services and essential technologies such as networking and CI/CD.
fundamentalsAwsDescription: Learn what services like EC2, S3 and IAM do and how to use them together.
fundamentalsNetworkingDescription: Follow network traffic to understand IP addresses, TCP, UDP, ports and routing.
fundamentalsDomainsDescription: Learn to register and manage domains and understand top-level domains, subdomains and delegation.
fundamentalsDnsDescription: Trace a DNS lookup and learn how A, AAAA, CNAME and NS records, TTL and caching work.
fundamentalsCidrDescription: Practice reading prefixes, calculating IP ranges and dividing a VPC into subnets.
fundamentalsCicdDescription: Learn how a pipeline tests, builds, deploys and rolls back changes.
studyEntry: Choose a certification, practice questions, take a mock exam and revisit mistakes.
assessmentEntry: Unsure which certification to pursue next? Your certifications and answers show a suggested order and which topics to review first.
